cases.translation: The boy looked healthy and cheerful.
cases.explain: Мальчик is the subject of имел (had), hence nominative.

cases.sentence: Он был очень болен после того ___ с матерью, которое мы не предусмотрели.
cases.translation: He was very ill after that meeting with his mother, which we had not foreseen.
cases.explain: The preposition после (after) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Мальчик подошел к ___ и подал ему записку о баллах, полученных в школе.
cases.translation: The boy went up to his father and handed him a note about his marks received at school.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Мальчик подошел к отцу и подал ему ___ о баллах, полученных в школе.
cases.translation: The boy went up to his father and handed him a note about his marks received at school.
cases.explain: Записку is the direct object of подал (handed/gave), hence accusative.

cases.sentence: ...вопросительно взглянув на отца, быстрым ___ вышел из комнаты.
cases.translation: ...having glanced questioningly at his father, he walked quickly out of the room.
cases.explain: Instrumental of manner (быстрым шагом = 'with a quick step') is used without a preposition.

cases.sentence: Мальчик подошел к отцу и подал ему записку о баллах, полученных в ___.
cases.translation: The boy went up to his father and handed him a note about his marks received at school.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case here, indicating location.

reading.ru: Глава девятнадцатая Степан Аркадьевич хотел уже уходить, когда Корней пришел доложить.
reading.question: What was happening when Korney came to announce something?
options: Stepan Arkadyich was about to leave
Stepan Arkadyich was writing a letter
reading.correct: Stepan Arkadyich was about to leave
reading.explain: Stepan Arkadyich was already about to leave when Korney came to announce someone.

reading.ru: Степан Аркадьевич понял, что означало это «если бы возможно».
reading.question: What did Stepan Arkadyich realize Anna's phrase 'if it were possible' meant?
options: That she hoped the divorce could be arranged so the son would be given to her
That she wanted to remarry immediately
That she wanted to leave Russia
That she no longer loved her son
reading.correct: That she hoped the divorce could be arranged so the son would be given to her
reading.explain: He understood 'if it were possible' meant if it were possible to arrange the divorce so the son would be given to her.

reading.ru: Но разумное лечение и морские купания летом исправили его здоровье, и теперь я по совету доктора отдал его в школу.
reading.question: How was Seryozha's health restored after he fell ill?
options: Through sensible treatment and sea bathing in summer
reading.correct: Through sensible treatment and sea bathing in summer
reading.explain: Karenin says sensible treatment and sea bathing in the summer restored his health.

reading.ru: И то не Сережа, а целый Сергей Алексеевич!» — улыбаясь, сказал Степан Аркадьевич, глядя на бойко и развязно вошедшего красивого широкого мальчика в синей курточке и длинных панталонах.
reading.question: How was Seryozha dressed when he entered the room?
options: In a blue jacket and long trousers
In a school uniform with a cap
reading.correct: In a blue jacket and long trousers
reading.explain: The text describes the handsome, broad boy entering in a blue jacket and long trousers.

reading.ru: Он поклонился дяде как чужому, но, узнав его, покраснел и точно обиженный и рассерженный чем-то поспешно отвернулся от него.
reading.question: How did Seryozha initially react upon recognizing his uncle?
options: He blushed and turned away as if offended and angry
He burst into tears of joy
reading.correct: He blushed and turned away as if offended and angry
reading.explain: Recognizing his uncle, he blushed and, as if offended and angered by something, hastily turned away from him.

reading.ru: Прошел год с тех пор, как Сережа видел в последний раз свою мать.
reading.question: How much time had passed since Seryozha last saw his mother?
reading.explain: A year had passed since Seryozha last saw his mother.

reading.ru: Те мечты и воспоминания о матери, которые после свидания с нею сделали его больным, теперь уже не занимали его.
reading.question: What effect had time had on Seryozha's memories and dreams of his mother?
options: They no longer occupied his thoughts as they once had
They had grown stronger and more painful
He wrote about them constantly in a diary
reading.correct: They no longer occupied his thoughts as they once had
reading.explain: The dreams and memories of his mother that had made him ill after their meeting no longer occupied him now.

reading.ru: «У нас теперь идет железная дорога», — сказал он, отвечая на его вопрос.
reading.question: What game was Seryozha playing with his schoolmates?
reading.explain: Seryozha explains that they now play a game called 'railway'.

reading.ru: «Это который стоя?» — спросил Степан Аркадьевич, улыбаясь.
reading.question: What did Stepan Arkadyich ask about, smiling, regarding the railway game?
reading.explain: Stepan Arkadyich, smiling, asked which one is the one standing up, referring to the conductor.

reading.ru: «А ты помнишь мать?» – вдруг спросил он.
reading.question: What sudden question did Stepan Arkadyich ask Seryozha, breaking his promise to Karenin?
options: Whether he wanted to visit Moscow
reading.explain: Although he had promised not to speak of Anna, Stiva could not resist and suddenly asked if Seryozha remembered his mother.

reading.ru: Обратился он уже не к гувернеру, а ко всему свету.
reading.question: By the end of the scene, to whom did Seryozha seem to be addressing his outburst 'Leave me alone'?
options: To the whole world, not just the tutor
To no one in particular, he was talking to himself quietly
reading.correct: To the whole world, not just the tutor
reading.explain: The text says he addressed his outburst no longer just to the tutor, but to the whole world.
